issue.title: Scheduler configuration
issue.author: ann
issue.body: How should the scheduler be configured?

comments.author: bob
comments.body:
Config:

```yaml
scheduler:
  kind: tick
  interval: 30s
```

That is all.

comments.author: cy
comments.body:
Full pipeline:

```text
step_01 load raw events
step_02 drop duplicate rows
step_03 join customer table
step_04 compute daily totals
step_05 write parquet files
step_06 refresh the dashboard
step_07 notify the channel
step_08 archive old partitions
```
